item.title: Tesla Cybercab sales open to invited buyers at $29,990 before tax
item.description: Tesla is inviting select customers to buy the two-seat Cybercab for personal use at $29,990 before taxes, with a $299 monthly subscription required to operate it.

item.title: Museum links 1820 bog find to gilded Roman emperor statue in Scotland
item.description: National Museums Scotland experts now believe a gilded bronze leg found in a bog near Hawick in 1820 came from a statue of Emperor Antoninus Pius on horseback.

item.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets Pro users approve purchases made by dots agents
item.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets its dots agents complete purchases for US Pro subscribers, who approve each payment while merchants receive a token instead of the card number.

item.title: SCKit malware hit at least 288 ScreenConnect endpoints, Huntress says
item.description: Huntress says the SCKit toolkit reached at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations in attacks on MSP-managed ScreenConnect environments, while ConnectWise disabled RMM+ family extensions.

item.title: Google releases Android 17 QPR3 Beta 4 with Pixel bug fixes
item.description: Google released Android 17 QPR3 Beta 4 for Pixel devices on November 12, 2026, with fixes for UI lag, launcher crashes, keyboard clipping and Bluetooth battery drain.

item.title: Carmelle wins first Eurovision Asia for Philippines with 211 points
item.description: CARMELLE of the Philippines won the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok with Sobra-Sobra, finishing on 211 points with 93 from juries and 118 from the public vote.

item.title: Microsoft confirms SQL Server linked server issue in Windows updates
item.description: Microsoft says Windows updates released on October 13, 2026, and later can leave SQL Server linked server connections open, and it plans an out-of-band fix.

item.title: LinkedIn expands connected TV ads to the UK for B2B advertisers
item.description: LinkedIn says UK advertisers can now run connected TV ads through its Campaign Manager, with LG, Paramount+ and Titan OS named in its announcement.

item.title: Police arrest 354 suspects in dark web cybercrime crackdown
item.description: Operation TorNado led to the arrest of 354 dark web vendors and buyers, with agencies from 14 countries taking part, according to the US Justice Department and security news reports.

item.title: Climate change made Indonesia fire season about 1.6°C hotter: study
item.description: A World Weather Attribution study found that El Niño drove the drought behind Indonesia's 2026 fires, while human-induced climate change made the August to October season about 1.6°C hotter.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Teams and Copilot Worldwide
item.description: Microsoft said a Microsoft 365 outage that began November 12, 2026 affected Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and Copilot, with recovery still under way.

item.title: Apache HTTP Server Patches Critical HTTP/2 Remote Code Execution Flaw

item.title: SpiceJet Shares Hit 5% Upper Circuit Ahead of Board Meeting
item.description: SpiceJet shares hit their 5% upper circuit on November 13, 2026, before the board meets on November 18 to consider a fresh capital raise.

item.title: India Retail Inflation Hits 6.09% in October 2026
item.description: Official data show India's October 2026 retail inflation at 6.09%, up from 5.54% in September, with food inflation at 8.94%.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns; Colette Kress Interim CEO
